$comment: Photography plate spec (team style guide). Sizes chosen so the plate never overpowers the frame: oversized chargers (32+ cm) make normal portions look tiny and leave empty glaze for light to reflect off. Only use a charger for an intentional wide table scene. The solver uses use_cm for the proxy; the prompt states use_cm and the attributes below.

lunch-plate.label: Salad / lunch plate (smaller mains)
lunch-plate.when: A small, delicate protein or a compact stack: the smaller plate makes the food look bountiful and fill the frame.

side-plate.label: Appetizer / side plate
side-plate.when: Side portions, single desserts, or bread flanking the main.

rim_width_cm.why: Wide rims push the food into a small area in the middle; a narrow rim or coupe gives the food the most surface.

lip_height_cm.why: High lips throw harsh shadows onto the food under side light or backlight.

finish.why: Glossy glaze gets blinding white hot spots under studio light.

prompt: with a narrow rim (or rimless coupe), a low, flat profile and a matte or satin glaze, never glossy
